Original Decipher card face for [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe]], as shown in the Third Anthology card list on Decipher's own website.

Source: [http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/thirdanthology/dark/images/theultimatepowerintheunive.gif theultimatepowerintheunive.gif], Decipher.com card list. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010628170206/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/thirdanthology/dark/images/theultimatepowerintheunive.gif Internet Archive], 28 June 2001. SHA-256 of the archived file: 4ecccfdfbbf59caa054efb34b31aedf784c2ca200c7f51150129ddb6a6f99ded.

Edits: none. The archived bytes are uploaded unchanged.

The Holotable face [[:File:TA-D-theultimatepowerintheuniverse.gif]] is a separate file and is not replaced by this file.

Fair use rationale: this is a low-resolution image of a copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. It is used only to identify and discuss the card on this non-commercial fan wiki, it does not replace any product sold today, and no free equivalent exists.

This published digital source is documented at [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe (Digital Image)]]. Its 7-side design has the digital-only incorrect formula identified by [[:File:SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf|Advanced Rulebook (2023)]], page 152. It is not evidence of a distinct physical printing. The corresponding first located 2018 repository files share the exact decoded card pixels after removing only this archive copy’s outer padding. Original file bytes and pre-existing source/credit information remain unchanged.
